voxy.config.title: Voxy
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of threads the ServiceThreadPool can use
Uses embeddium builder threads as part of voxys thread pool, can reduce stuttering and lag when moving quickly at high render distance
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: Maximum size in pixels (squared) of screenspace AABB before subdiving to smaller LoDs (Smaller being higher quality)
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: Render distance of voxy in chunks
voxy.config.general.camera_distance_cull: Controls distance-based LOD residency/unload around the camera. Disable for low-CPU traversal testing (memory usage grows).
voxy.config.general.visibility_culling.t: Controls frustum/HiZ/section visibility culling. Keep ON for GPU efficiency; disable only for CPU-overhead experiments.
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Enables or disables voxy rendering environmental fog
voxy.config.general.shader_pack_fog_over: Prevents shader pack fog from hiding distant LODs
voxy.config.general.render_fog.tooltip: Enables or disables render fog effect
voxy.config.general.render_statistics.to: Enable render statistics in F3 menu, useful for debugging
voxy.config.general.loading_indicator.to: Shows/hides the Voxy loading/progress HUD overlay
voxy.config.general.render_distance_offs: Extra chunk rings added to the LOD depth-mask radius. 0 = exact vanilla/Embeddium boundary. Positive = expand mask outward, negative = shrink inward. Live update.
Fine-tunes the depth mask boundary in blocks. Positive = shrink mask (LODs bleed inward, hides gap). Negative = expand mask. 0 = exact match. Live update — adjust while flying to find the sweet spot.
voxy.config.general.section_visibility_c: Pads per-section visibility culling outward in world blocks. Higher values reduce screen-edge pop-in while panning, at the cost of some extra offscreen rendering.
voxy.config.general.earth_curve_ratio.to: 0 = flat world, 50-5000 = curvature strength (higher = smaller planet)
